description: What was the US market regime at the last close? Returns the newest settled Regime Card reading, the same one regimecard.com shows: a score from 0 to 100, one of five regimes, the eight cross-asset category labels, and the paid routes with their prices. Free. One reading per US trading day, settled at 4:30 PM ET. Useful as a free first look at the response shape and the paid routes.
name: sample_reading
title: Latest settled market regime (free)
